source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each time a melee attack destroys one of this unit's models that is yet to fight this phase, roll 1 D6 (+1 if your army's units have [Fortify Takeover](vsdata:ability/leagues-of-votann.prioritised-efficiency)).

A result of 4+ keeps the model in play: it may fight once the attacking unit finishes its attacks, then remove it.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.event: each source-unit model destroyed by melee attack

modifier.if: units from your army have Fortify Takeover
